whenToUse: The single most important condition in pricing or benefit details.
A phrase that must be remembered within a long sentence.
A section seen for the first time after scrolling down.
whenNotToUse: Several places in one paragraph (the emphasis fades).
Colors that could look like links.
Emphasizing only favorable terms while hiding unfavorable ones.
accessibility: It's a mark element, so the emphasis carries meaning too.
Without the observer, or with reduced motion, it appears already painted.
The text color stays the same and only the background is painted, so contrast holds.
Once painted, it isn't erased again.
